spans.text: So you've already taken a look around this place?
We arrived even earlier than you. It's not like we've just been hanging around doing nothing.
The mansion isn't actually that big.
The actual area is a lot smaller than its exterior appearance may suggest, probably because of the thick walls.
I didn't expect the electrical room to be somewhere so obvious...
In fact, it can be very easily overlooked precisely because it's hidden in plain sight.
I noticed that when I was doing my investigation. Didn't expect it to come in useful.
This mansion's furnishings are very retro, but the electrical room is equipped with very sophisticated technology.
If all that power is just for the purpose of providing illumination, it's a bit of an overkill.
Without a doubt...there are other electrical appliances in this mansion.
Well done, Type 56-1. You've saved us a lot of time.
It's just a normal tripped fuse. Nothing serious.
We'll just have to switch it back on.
That's good to hear. Then let's get the power running again.
Miss Lee, please inform Miss MDR and have her return to the church as well.
MDR, we've located the electrical room and restored power. Please acknowledge.
Nothing but static comes through the channel.
